title: Occipital
summary: OCCIP'ITAL, adjective [from Latin occiput, the back part of the heat; ob and caput.] Pertaining to the back part of the head, or to the occiput.

inlines.v: OCCIP'ITAL, adjective [from Latin occiput, the back part of the heat; ob and caput.] Pertaining to the back part of the head, or to the occiput.
